additional_info.subject: Re: ID0474151-DC/Si-D/CZ- [MP / R7 170002202] Converter Group & QA21-22 Flags CRM:03288000205
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I am confident the issue is recurring. Please see the screenshot of the logs for the timestamp. I believe you have access to the AWS logs so please check there how often this issue happens. We have monitored this charger for the past month and the occurrences are very frequent.
I will be looking forward to see your analysis of the issue and I am ready to replace those contactors tomorrow once I have a green light from you.
Kind regards,
Milan

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0474151-DC/Si-D/CZ- [MP / R7 170002202] Converter Group & QA21-22 Flags CRM:03288000205
additional_info.body:
Dear support,
Yesterday, I was on-site and completed the following steps:
Coolant top-up
Test of contactors QA21-QA22
Voltage applied across XD41:37B and 25B (QA21) - Contactor functioning as expected
Voltage applied across XD41:38D and 26D (QA22) - Contactor functioning as expected
Charging after contactor verification OK.
Error did not occur during multiple charging sessions between 15:00 and 18:45
29.01.2026
Remote inspection. The following error flags are active again on the station:
Converter_Group_DC1  PLC      SYSTEM          true      direct ogc possibly welded
outlet1  sicharge-cp      OUTLET           true       Outlet 1: outoforder, MeterState: Working
Outlet_DC1_codes       PLC      INFO    true       DC1 Errorcode:7.10
DC_Contactor_DC1_QA21-22   PLC      DEVICE            true      dc contactor pair of output DC1
Once the weather conditions allow, we will replace the contactors QA21-22.
Since the charger is under warranty, we will be claiming the costs.
Best regards,
Milan
